description: Look up who is behind a phone number in the Netherlands, Belgium or Luxembourg: community reports, spam and scam categories, a trust verdict, and the registered business if there is one, from the Calmido phone directory. Use it whenever someone asks who called them, whether a number is safe, spam or a scam, or which company a number belongs to. Accepts international (+31 20 123 4567) and national (020 123 4567) formats; pass `country` for a national number outside the Netherlands.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of a national-format number. Defaults to NL, then BE and LU are tried.

language.description: Language of the summary sentence: nl, en or fr. Defaults to en.

number.description: The phone number, international (+31 20 123 4567) or national (020 123 4567).

name: lookup_phone_number
title: Look up a phone number (Calmido)
